description: The plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the evolution of the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers for three distinct cases: the hidden state mean before the gate, the hidden state mean after the gate, and the hidden state mean of the baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to 22 and is measured on a linear scale, representing the layer number within the model. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," also uses a linear scale and ranges from 0 to 4, indicating the absolute mean of the hidden states. The blue dashed line, representing the "hidden state mean before gate," begins at a value of approximately 0.1 and remains relatively stable at a low level until around layer 20, after which it experiences a sharp increase, peaking at a value of approximately 4.3. The orange dotted line, representing the "hidden state mean after gate," starts at a value of about 0.05 and shows a very slight, gradual increase, ending at a value of approximately 0.15. The green solid line, representing the "hidden state mean of baseline," remains nearly constant at a value of approximately 0.04 throughout all layers. The legend provides the average values for each line: 0.71 for the blue dashed line, 0.05 for the orange dotted line, and 0.04 for the green solid line.
